scope: Own exact performance/startup v2 transformations; Source text/data only

edits.new:
#include "../web/performance.h"
#ifndef NODE_COMPAT_NEXT_PERFORMANCE
#error Startup v2 requires genuine deployed performance origin support
#endif

# Source v2 startup has an explicit, deployed-only epoch/monotonic backend.
option(NODE_COMPAT_NEXT_PERFORMANCE "Deployed Unix performance origin and double elapsed clock" OFF)
if(NODE_COMPAT_NEXT_STARTUP AND NOT NODE_COMPAT_NEXT_PERFORMANCE AND NOT CMAKE_SCRIPT_MODE_FILE)
    message(FATAL_ERROR "Startup v2 requires NODE_COMPAT_NEXT_PERFORMANCE=ON")
endif()
if(NODE_COMPAT_NEXT_PERFORMANCE AND NOT CMAKE_SCRIPT_MODE_FILE)
    if(NOT NODE_COMPAT_NEXT_STARTUP OR NOT TARGET builtin_web_performance)
        message(FATAL_ERROR "NODE_COMPAT_NEXT_PERFORMANCE requires startup and real native performance")
    endif()
    target_compile_definitions(extension_api INTERFACE NODE_COMPAT_NEXT_PERFORMANCE=1)
    add_dependencies(builtin_node_compat builtin_web_performance)
    target_link_libraries(builtin_node_compat PRIVATE builtin_web_performance)
endif()
